observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a white projector with 'EPSON' and 'V535S' clearly visible on the surface. The unit is wrapped in plastic. Buttons for Home, Menu, Power, etc., are visible. HDMI port label is present on the bottom left.
Photo 1 shows the same projector from a slightly different angle, confirming the EPSON brand and V535S model. Other similar projectors are visible in the background, also wrapped in plastic.

Photo 2 shows the rear panel of the projector, revealing multiple ports: VGA (blue), HDMI, audio out (red/white), composite video (yellow), and a power input. The unit is still wrapped in plastic. A serial number sticker is visible but not fully legible.
